description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types associated with article generation, as observed in a study of generative AI’s use in journalism. The chart contains two slices representing different task types. A larger, red slice is labeled “Task” and occupies approximately 83.2% of the chart’s area, while a smaller, yellow slice is labeled “Headline” and comprises the remaining portion. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The chart includes a legend identifying the task types, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size, with “Task” appearing first.
